name: Vocational Education Fee Reimbursement.
description: Under this scheme students who are enrolled for vocational education courses like, Engineering, Pharmacy , Animal Husbandry, Dairy Development, Vaastu Shastra, MBA, MCA can take benefit. Applicant whose parent income limit is above 2.5 Lakhs can apply for the scheme.

criteria.label: Family annual income limit is RS. > 2,50,000

evidence.quote: Family annual income limit is RS. > 2,50,000

benefits.text: Tuition Fee and Exam Fees As per approved college fee structure

evidence.quote: Tuition Fee and Exam Fees As per approved college fee structure

documents.name: Caste certificate issued by Competent authority.

evidence.quote: Caste certificate issued by Competent authority.

renewal:
The student have to pass the previous year examination
If student fails in any year then he is not paid the scholarship for that particular year
applicationProcess: For Academic Year 2026-27, apply on the MahaDBT 2.0 portal (fresh and renewal applications). The scheme page on MahaDBT 1.0 remains the information source.

applicationUrlEvidence.quote: Fresh and renewal applications for the Academic Year 2026-27 will be accepted only through the MahaDBT 2.0 Portal.
